fullDescription:
“Hepune” is a sophisticated elegant stylish serif typeface that epitomizes luxury and modern artistic flair. Characterized by its high-contrast strokes and exceptionally tall x-height, this font features a unique blend of sharp, traditional serifs and dramatic, fluid curves. The standout feature is its alternate stylistic ligatures, which incorporate expansive, sweeping swashes and intricate circular flourishes that extend far beyond the letterforms, creating a high-end, bespoke feel.

Hepune will perfect for many project: book, magazines, logo, branding, photography, quotes, blog header, poster, advertisements, etc.
